nonblocking_findings: C6-1 [Minor] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:6-11 and :95-114, measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:211 and :772-781: The format of the approval record exists only in the publish.ts header. Spec D21 says that the orchestrator writes the record after Daniel gives his word, and the data model says the record holds `the words of Daniel`. The format has no field for his words, and it does not say where free text may go. The parser (:103-113) fails with `publish: bad line <text>` on any non-blank line after `files:` that is not a row, so a quote of Daniel placed after `files:` stops the publish. The header says `<YYYY-MM-DD>` but the code accepts any non-empty `date:` text. The row regex (:109) accepts lower-case hex only. Fix: add one sample record to spec D21 or to the plan task that writes the record. State that free text goes before `files:`, that `files:` is the last section, and that hex is lower-case. Validate the date or change the header to `<date>`.

C6-2 [Minor] review-c: harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:9 and :237-261: The header says the checks run in the order `input, json, manifest, sha256, size, schema, run-sum`. The code runs input (:237), manifest (:240), sha256 (:247), size (:250), manifest again for the sum-line file name (:252), json (:258), schema, and run-sum. A non-JSON input with no MANIFEST.txt gives `input-check: manifest`, not `json`. The header also gives no text for `manifest`, `sha256`, and `size`. Fix: correct the order in the header and add one line for each of the three checks.

C6-3 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:97 and :164, harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:241, :243, and :502-503: These calls have no guard. An unreadable MANIFEST.txt or input file (real-work.ts:241, :243), an unreadable preview file (publish.ts:164, `sha256File`), an approval record that is not a file (publish.ts:97), and an unwritable `--out` folder (real-work.ts:502-503) throw. The run then ends with exit 1 and a stack trace on stderr. The headers promise exit 0 or 2 and one line on stdout. By code trace; the sandbox denied chmod, so I could not run these cases. Fix: wrap each call and refuse with `input-check: input`, `publish: sha256 <path>`, `publish: bad approval record`, and a new named line. Or state the limit in the headers.

C6-4 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:49 and :220-222: The root case of C5-2 is closed. Header line 42 and code line 130 both give `publish: drift .`. The sentence `Each refusal prints one line on stdout` stays. The drift step prints one line for each drifted entry, so two or more lines are possible. Fix: write `Each refusal prints one line, except drift, which prints one line for each entry.`

C5-1 [Minor] review-c: measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:95 and :663-667 (carried; no change in 8eafbc3..2a9d421): No planned Red task pins one `Real work` link and one `Review` link on each docs page before task 4.8. Plan line 95 still says `each page` with no Phase 1 limit. The `Review` link in the preview index.html is a dead link until task 4.8 writes review.html (no docs/review.html exists). Fix: add a Red task before 4.8 for the nav links on every page, and add one sentence to plan line 95 that names the dead Review link in Phases 1 to 3.
